faq.q: Does it work with every phone?
faq.a: Every iPhone since the XR and nearly all Android phones read NFC with no app. For anything else, the QR code does the same job.

faq.q: Can I get my own logo on it?
faq.a: Yes. Custom-printed cards and stands start at 125 pieces. Request a quote or text (781) 985-0916 and we’ll send pricing and a design proof.
Yes. Google encourages businesses to ask for reviews. Just ask every customer, not only the happy ones, and don't offer discounts or rewards in exchange.

faq.q: Can I change where it goes later?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us before we ship and we'll program the new link. After that, text us and we'll reprogram it or send a replacement.
5–10 business days after we confirm your links. Local to the Boston area? Ask about hand delivery in your order notes.

faq.q: Can I order for multiple locations?
faq.a: Yes. For more than 50 cards or several locations, text (781) 985-0916 for volume pricing.
Every piece is tested before it ships. If anything arrives damaged or won't scan, we replace it free.
